textDescription:
Resolves YES if AI is reported by reputable sources to have solved one of the 'Unsolved problems' on this webpage: https://www.claymath.org/millennium-problems/

Resolves NO otherwise

Clarification: There should have been no human assistance whatsoever in solving the problem. AI-assisted proofs do not count for resolution.
